purpose: Materialize and seal one immutable native perception mesh for every frozen V2R parent after M0F passed all ten train recipe sentinels.

approval.scope: One M1 implementation and one formal execution producing exactly 100 primary assets, 80 train previews and zero replay/LiDAR/data/training.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after the exact M1 proposal was presented.

source.reuse_policy: M1 creates all 100 assets from scratch; M0F meshes remain diagnostic sealed evidence and are not copied into M1.

split_isolation: Only train maps may be manually inspected. Validation and development-test assets receive predeclared automatic checks but cannot guide thresholds, parameters, repair or parent selection.
downstream_policy: Later CPU LiDAR/data generation may only read accepted sealed M1 OBJ files; remeshing substitution is forbidden.
failure_policy: Any source, quality, scope, split-isolation or seal failure stops and seals FAIL; no retry or replacement.
next_stage_boundary: M1 PASS permits only a separate CPU LiDAR and objective-label data-contract proposal.
